classification_rationale: The customer asserts that there is no deadline for disputing invoices, a claim about Haapaharju Oy's own policy that needs to be corrected with the actual term.

draft.reply_body:
Hello,

Thanks for reaching out. I do want to correct one thing: invoice queries need to be raised within 30 days of the invoice date under our policy, so it isn't open-ended. That said, if the charges you're querying turn out to be a clear error - the wrong rate applied or a simple calculation mistake - we can correct those at any time, regardless of when the invoice was issued.

Could you send me the invoice number or date, along with which line items look wrong to you? I'll take a look and let you know either way.

Best regards,
Haapaharju Oy Customer Service

commitments.description: Corrected the customer's understanding that invoice disputes have no deadline: the general policy is a 30-day window, though clear invoicing errors can still be corrected at any time
